56431f3e820e255605aa40ba4927121fff1ddd50.summary: The German Federal Office for the Protection of the Constitution (BfV) warned that APT27, a Chinese cyberespionage group also known as Emissary Panda, has repeatedly attacked German companies since at least March 2021. The attacks exploited unpatched internet-exposed servers, using Microsoft Exchange and Zoho ManageEngine ADSelfService Plus flaws, to install the HyperBro malware for intelligence collection. The BfV said it cannot rule out supply chain attacks and published indicators of compromise. The report places this within a wider trend of Chinese hacking against large German companies.

5680c21a347bfdc57a46d79a2acb6749a0c88f0c.summary: Uptycs Threat Research describes the 8220 Gang, a Chinese-based threat actor, running a cryptomining campaign against cloud infrastructure from May 2023 to February 2024. The Windows chain uses PowerShell fileless execution, AMSI and ETW patching, DLL sideloading and a UAC bypass to deploy a miner. The Linux variant is a shell-script downloader that disables defenses, sets persistence via services and cron jobs, scans for SSH with masscan and spirit, brute-forces hosts, and drops a miner and Tsunami IRCBot. The report calls the Linux campaign largely unchanged and the Windows tactics new.

567d7954f121d020d233fa306b107a187ca21263.summary: Mandiant report on DARKSIDE ransomware-as-a-service, first seen in August 2020 and affecting organisations in more than 15 countries. Affiliates run multifaceted extortion, stealing data and threatening to publish it. The report tracks five activity clusters, including UNC2628, UNC2659 and UNC2465, which use legitimate and commercial tools such as Cobalt Strike, Mimikatz, Rclone and PsExec. One cluster exploited a SonicWall SSL VPN flaw, CVE-2021-20016, which has since been patched. The report also records the operators announcing a closure in May 2021, which Mandiant had not independently…
